audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text is generic and mis-genders Karma ('he', 'his sidestep tool'). Karma has no dash or sidestep tool in her kit.
audit.why: Karma's kit (Q Inner Flame 950 range projectile, W Focused Resolve 675 tether root, E Inspire shield + move speed, R Mantra 40/38/36/34s) contains no dash. Advice built on 'burning his sidestep tool' is fabricated and unactionable.
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty is a range war: Anivia's Flash Frost reaches 1075, Karma's Inner Flame 950. She is immobile, so a landed Q is a full trade; the danger is stepping inside 675 where Focused Resolve roots.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagrees between layers: phases[3..6].side reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while win[3..6] reads Karma/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia and the packet levelChart reads Karma,Karma,Karma,Karma,Anivia,Anivia,Anivia.
audit.why: Two layers render two different answers to the same row. Packet chart and content layer agree with each other and with the 54.3% Anivia win rate, so the full layer is the wrong one.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side = Karma; phases[4..6].side = Anivia, matching win[3..6] and the packet chart. Spikes: Lost Chapter ends the mana war, level 6 Glacial Storm inverts tempo, Seraph's/RoA makes the storm permanent; Karma's own spike is Mantra availability at level 1 accelerated by Gathering Fire.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions are never stated: Gathering Fire refunds Mantra cooldown off every damaging hit she lands, Mantra W heals her through extended trades, and Crystallize can break the Focused Resolve tether.
audit.why: Karma's passive text is explicit that damaging abilities reduce Mantra's cooldown, so eating free Inner Flames literally buys her the next empowered root. Mantra W's text states it heals her and extends the root, which is the anti-heal trigger flagged in missingInteractions. Focused Resolve roots only if the tether is not broken.
audit.corrected: Deny free Inner Flame hits — each one shaves her 40s Mantra. In extended trades Mantra W heals her while it roots you, so Grievous Wounds decides long fights. Crystallize (17s) placed between you breaks the tether before the root lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d cite a 'fifteen-second' Focused Resolve.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank per Riot's data.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere despite Mantra W healing.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb before committing to any long fight against a Mantra-W Karma.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pronouns throughout the full layer refer to Karma as male.
audit.why: Karma is female; a paying reader sees the page as machine-generated.
audit.corrected: Feminine pronouns in every rewritten field.

edits.before: He needs a full combo to pop the egg AND the bird — make the combo cost a stun to attempt.
edits.after: She cannot burst the egg — she pokes. Your Q reaches 1075 to her 950, so win the range war.

edits.before: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve (Tether), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Karma wins by rooting you with Focused Resolve inside 675 and letting Gathering Fire refund Mantra off every free poke hit she lands.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Karma burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Q her as she steps up to last-hit, then E the chilled target for double damage and walk — she has no dash, so a landed Flash Frost is a full free trade.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Karma walks straight at you.
edits.after: Trading into her shield — Inspire is up every 8-10s and each hit she lands shaves Mantra's 40s timer toward the next root.

edits.before: Good trade: Threaten Q until Karma burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade. Bad trade: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Karma walks straight at you.
edits.after: Good trade: Q her step-up, then E the chilled target for double damage and walk — she has no dash to escape it. Bad trade: extended chip into Mantra W, which heals her while it roots you, so buy Oblivion Orb before you commit to a long fight. Her Inner Flame reaches 950; your Q reaches 1075.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. It governs your forward steps. - W Crystallize spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve: 12s flat at every rank, 675 range — outside that she has only Inner Flame. - Mantra: 40s at rank 1, but Gathering Fire cuts it with every hit she lands, so denying poke delays her root. - Crystallize is 17s; it is your Flash.

edits.before: If Karma gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Focused Resolve (Tether) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with R wave-clear and stay relevant through zone control.
edits.after: If Karma gets a kill her Mantra shield can cover a jungle dive, so hold Q for the diver, not for her. Two kills: farm under tower with R, stay outside 675, and let her spend Mantra on waveclear instead of on you.

edits.before: Carry by controlling space — storm and wall decide where fights happen, and your stun decides who dies first inside them.
edits.after: Carry by out-ranging her: storm the choke she has to shield through, and Q whoever her Inspire speeds forward — chilled E finishes them.

edits.before: Ahead, the lane is a prison: storm every wave, wall Karma away from the comeback farm, and rotate first to every river fight with your stun loaded.
edits.after: Ahead, deny her the reset: Mantra shield only matters in range, so storm the wave from outside her 950 and wall her off the side lane she wants to farm.

edits.before: - Anivia vs Karma - Track: Karma Focused Resolve (Tether). - Hold Q for his engage — never spend the stun on poke. - No commits into Focused Resolve (Tether). - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Anivia vs Karma - Track: Focused Resolve, 12s flat. - Hold Q for her step-up, never for poke. - Do not stand inside 675 while her root is up. - Crystallize between you breaks the tether before it roots.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Karma burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Crystallize between you and her breaks the Focused Resolve tether before the root lands — 17s cooldown, so spend it on her W, never on the wave.

edits.before: Karma burns Focused Resolve (Tether) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Karma burns Focused Resolve on a minion — you have twelve free seconds of ground.

edits.before: Waste the stun on poke he can sidestep
edits.after: Waste the stun on poke she sidesteps

edits.before: Poke relentlessly with Mantra Q while you have no answer for sustained rangeless trades
edits.after: Land Inner Flame on you repeatedly so Gathering Fire refunds Mantra for the next root
